title: PoppyFeedbackRequest
description: PAP 0.3 feedback report. Personal agents send kind=missing; receiving Companies must also accept unknown kinds. Send with a Session Token and DPoP, without account scopes, identifiers or secrets. Accept HTTP 202 with no body or HTTP 200 with a PoppyAlternative. Do not report an excluded task.

kind.description: PAP 0.3 senders use missing. Receivers accept unknown future kinds.
